title: The Clock Tower Chimes Calculation
description:
📝 Witness Deposition:
Clock tower chimes 4 times at top of hour, followed by hour gongs.
Detective hears 4 prelude chimes followed by 10 deep gongs.
question: What time is it (e.g. 10:00)?
hints: 4 prelude chimes signal top of the hour.
Count of deep gongs = Hour of the day (10 gongs = 10 o'clock).
solution: 4 prelude chimes = top of hour; 10 gongs = 10:00.
